name: Dokibird in: The Tale of the Dubious Doppelgänger
source:
Doki is made aware of a certain thief who looks mysteriously similar to her, leading her to an event she'd never had imagined...

A short visual novel starring the shining Bounty Hunter VTuber Dokibird! Expect a thrilling adventure as she goes on the search for a thief impersonating her. And maybe save a temple along the way(Or not).

[From [url=https://spinecricket.itch.io/doki-doppelganger]itch.io[/url]]
